up: List all distinct compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2448811. For each compound, retrieve the following fields from the molecule_dictionary table: its ChEMBL ID, preferred name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and from the compound_structures table its canonical SMILES. Only include compounds that are linked to the document through the compound_records table (i.e., compound_records.doc_id matches the doc_id of the document CHEMBL2448811). Order the results by the compound's ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2448811'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
